[quote=western_view;60242527]Speech by current Head Council John Fredrickson

"Tro Pecally, Protersty, ak Litery E Prosher."

"In this day and age, our world is flawed, broken at the seams. With the revolution in Velmara, the pollitical mess that was once Elnire, Hatsur Zatsugi and the Guhui'Bernardio, and of course the wars that have raged across the world. But we, we still stand, we still fight, we fight or freedom, we fight for our country and our culture, we fight to be us. But so many people can't fight for those things, so we must fight for them. We must give them the strength and courage to keep moving. But even then, we say it's not enough, we need to bring peace to the world, but not by fighting, by showing others how to keep moving, how to keep saying 'This isn't right, we need to fix it.' So, I stand with you today not to tell you to give up, but to keep fighting the good fight, to keep being kind safe, and you."

Letter to The Kingdom of Elnire

"Elnire, we here in Western View hope that you are able to fix the political problem you are currently experencing, and we wish you the best of luck, may the Divine Gods solve your problem. We also wish that you would let us help you, being a fellow IPEA member, we want you not to feel alone in this growing crisis. And so I wish that me sending this to you gives you one thing, strength, to keep fighting, to keep hoping, and to keep living in the unfortunately awkward situation you have found yourself in."

"Best of Luck, John Fredrikson"

[spoiler=[b]Assembly of the Conspirators[/b]

[i]- Haupstadt District of Neudresden -[/i]]A black SUV winds through the grid-like streets of Neudresden. Raindrops pour onto the windows, headlights slice into the night ahead. Due to the poor weather, heavy rainfall forecasted for the next week, scarcely many people are on the streets.

At three in the morning the city felt dead.

Only small groups of beggars can be seen, taking some rest before they are eventually shooed away by the Neudresden Polizei. Eventually, the car arrives before the Central Military Commission Offices in the Hauptstadt District. Its approach gradually slows as it nears the two guard booths that compose the entrance to the building. An officer steps out of his booth into the rain, eyeing the car wearily.

Slowly the driver's side window rolls down.

[b]Identification.[/b]

The man reaches onto his dashboard and hands the officer several papers. His eyes flicker over the identification card. Then a sharp draw of breath comes as he reads the mans name.

[b]Gen. Müller[/b]

He glances back up at the man in the car.

Without another word he retreats back into the booth to raise the barrier.

The Central Military Commission Offices, like many of the other government buildings that populate the Haupstadt District had a storied history. Its neoclassical structure with large corinthian columns guarding the entrance, balustrade and elaborate reliefs had nearly a century of Kaiserreich military history. Within the halls of the building the fate of Kaisers, countries, and entire peoples had been decided by the Reichswehr military machine. Now several men, Mr. Müller included, walk its halls on a seemingly unimportant rainy Monday night in a bid to completely change the Kaiserreich.

The granite clinks under the General's shoes as he makes his way across the hallways. At the end of the hallway he opens a large pair of oak doors to find the other three men. Lieutenaut General Vogel, Vice Admiral Krause and General Keller all sat around the large circular table.

Vogel rose and clasped Müllers hand firmly. [b]Müller. Weve been waiting for you.[/b]

Müller allowed a tight smile. [b]Well Im here now gentlemen. Let's discuss business.[/b]

Müller tosses a small manila folder across the table towards the three other men. [b]There's been talk of peace with the Hydronians.[/b]

He sips the water laid out before them on the desk before continuing. [b]The Kaiser, Sturmfels and the rest of the Commission are out in Büdingen with WMW. We either act now or we wait another month.[/b]

Vogel nods his head as Müller speaks. [b]We wait and we lose momentum. That dog Sturmfels and the Cyberverteidigung are already sniffing around the Armee.
[/b]
Krause shakes his head and lays down the folder. [b]Nasty business. The Kaiser has still not approved action to restore Nestorstaat through action against the Enkians.[/b]

Keller leans towards the General. [b]Is the Fifth Armored with us? Müller, we need assurances.[/b]

[b]They are. But the Colonel is cautioustoo cautious.[/b]

The room falls silent save for the ticking clock mounted on the back wall.

Müller lights a cigarette. The light briefly illuminates his face before he exhales and speaks again. [b]Ill speak with the Colonel. However, until then I expect everything we have discussed here to remain absolutely sealed.[/b]

The men nodded and rose. The meeting was over.[/spoiler]

The delivery and distrubution of the 'Antibodies' injection have helped many Aboriginals in Aboria and the members of of the Olian comunities in Ostland in fighting of the more deadly effects of the Lyondar virus tough some was unfortunatly to far gone to save, it also seem to have added another layer in the fight to stop and limit its ability to spread to almoust zero.

Many injections have also been delivered to the Republic of Datia to help their situation, but their situation remains more severe then in Nordiheim as their far higher population density combined with the fact that their population is majority Aboriginal means that the Lyondar virus have been able to spread far more virally and claimed more victims making the situation there more severe.
As such mr. Warrin Nullah'Kardu, who remains the president untill the union of our two nations are compleat, have pleaded with the council of Nordiheim for not only top priorety in geting the potential vaccine but also for it to be shiped and used on their population before the vaccines tests have been fully compleat as he revealed the true extent of the viruses spread and death toll in Datia.
His report claims that almoust 400'000 have been infected and already over half of them have died, someting that shocked the council and made them question him why they had not been notefied of how terrible the situation realy was.

Mr. Warrin said that despite all the help and aid they had recived from Nordiheim, someting that had absolutely helped to keep it from being even worse then it was, the virus had been able to go under the radar in their nation as they lacked the ability to find out how bad it was as their hospitals and goverment could not comunicate propperly, and as a result it took them far longer to understand how far and bad the situation was and their hospital system were breaking under the immense presure.
This stemmed from the many decades of coruption that they had only been able to get under controll in 2017 with the ousting of their corrupt elite, wich Nordiheim had helped them with.

Because of the severity of Datias situation the council decided to use one of its 'emegency' powers to circumvent the normal laws of medical testing and decided with a unanimous vote to send the first batch of the vaccine to try and prevent the situation from potentialy reach a breaking point.
Luckely a production run was allready in production in antisipation of the vaccine being usable.
[i]((Again, joust to avoid confusion, Datia is a "NPC" nation that is part of my next expansion))[/i]

On a more hopefull note, the testing of the potential vaccine are going forward with possitive results, the first and secound batch of volunteers have succesfully shown that their bodies are creating the antibodies recvired to fight the Lyondar virus with the third batch showing a similar development.
There have also been no signs of allergic or undesirable reactions from the vaccine, someting the researcher say is because could use 'cell cultures' instead of the older and slower "egg" method to grow and cultivate the LV2B virus variant.
Only the results of the 4th and 5th test baches remains to be gained.
As a result of these wonderfull results it have been desided to take the gamble of puting the Lyondar Virus Vaccine, also known as OVT2-LV Vaccine among the medical scientists, into full production in anticipation that these 2 last batches will show the same good results.

Ones the last results are inn the council will declare mandatory vaccination of the whole nation to "choke out" the Lyondar virus in the whole nation to prevent as many Nordiheimian as posible from dying from it.
While the council understand that this will not be popular they ask all Nordiheimians to remember the secound vow:
[b][u]UNITY, With it we overcome![/u][/b][/spoiler]
